title: mapbox.token deprecation expired 2026-05-01: logs "IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED" while the option still works
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

The `mapbox.token` config option is declared with `expiration_date="2026-05-01"`, which is now in the past. `ConfigOption.is_expired()` therefore returns `True`, and anyone who still sets the option is told it **is no longer supported** — at `ERROR` level — even though the option is still read and still works (`lib/streamlit/elements/map.py` passes it through to the PyDeck spec).

The result is a contradiction: the log says the setting has been removed, the product still honours it, and the message quotes a removal date that has already passed.

### Reproducible Code Example

`.streamlit/config.toml`:

```toml
[mapbox]
token = "pk.example"
```

Then start any app, or check the state directly:

```python
import streamlit.config as config

config.get_config_options()
opt = config._config_options_template["mapbox.token"]
print(opt.expiration_date, opt.is_expired())   # 2026-05-01 True
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Set `mapbox.token` in `config.toml` (or via `STREAMLIT_MAPBOX_TOKEN`).
2. Start the app and read the console.

### Expected Behavior

One of the following, consistently:

- The option is actually removed, and setting it is a no-op with a clear message; or
- The expiration date is moved out to a real future release, so users see the "IS DEPRECATED … will be removed on or after `<future date>`" warning instead.

### Current Behavior

```
════════════════════════════════════════════════
mapbox.token IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED.

Instead of this, you should use either the MAPBOX_API_KEY environment
variable or PyDeck's `api_keys` argument.

Please update <path to config.toml>.
════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

logged at `ERROR` level, while `config.get_option("mapbox.token")` still returns the token and `st.map` still uses it.

### Relevant Source

`lib/streamlit/config.py:1384-1398` declares the option; `lib/streamlit/config_option.py:262-297` selects the expired vs. not-expired message.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `mapbox.token` is either removed or given a future expiration date.
- [ ] The message users see matches whether the option actually still functions.
- [ ] Ideally, a test or CI check fails when a deprecated config option's `expiration_date` passes, so this does not drift again.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

Not a regression — a deprecation that has quietly aged past its own deadline.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.62.0 (`develop`, commit `2ac0d77d3`)
- Python version: 3.13.6
- Operating System: Windows 11 (platform-independent)
- Browser: n/a

### Additional Information

`mapbox.token` is currently the only deprecated option in `config.py`, so it is also the only one exercising this code path.

comments.body:
`mapbox.token` was deprecated in #11231 with `expiration_date="2026-05-01"`. That date is now in the past, so `ConfigOption.is_expired()` is true and setting the option logs **ERROR** `IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED`. Expiration only changes the log text: the option is still registered, still readable via `config.get_option("mapbox.token")`, and still applied in `st.map`, `st.pydeck_chart`, and `_fix_pydeck_mapbox_api_warning()` (which copies it into `MAPBOX_API_KEY`). Unit tests still assert the token is forwarded to the proto. There is no CI check that a deprecated option’s expiration date has passed, so this drifted without a corresponding removal. Fix is to either remove the option (and stop reading it) or push the expiration date so the message matches current behavior.

### Related Issues

- [#16676](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/16676) — Companion bug in the same `ConfigOption.set_value()` warning path (stray `s` that also breaks `textwrap.dedent()`). That branch is currently hard to hit because `mapbox.token` is already expired and takes the “no longer supported” path instead.
- [#11399](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11399) — Closed `st.map` bug where `mapbox.token` was not applied. Maintainers confirmed the token should still be honored if set, and noted the option was already deprecated in favor of `MAPBOX_API_KEY`. Shows the option is still a live fallback, not a no-op.
